summary: Lookout tower built behind the Des Lacs refuge headquarters in 1936 and moved across the river to a hill in 1937; no source says whether it survives.

facts.status_note: Moved across the river in July 1937; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as removed.

access.note: Visitors can hike the refuge trails or drive the auto route; no source describes the tower site itself.

corrections.why: The compiled list says the tower was moved in July 1937 to a hill near the golf course. No source says it was demolished, so 'gone' may overstate the record. No source records where it stands now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says Removed and the compiled list says the tower moved in 1937. Both fit a tower that left the headquarters grounds; neither says whether it survives.

sources.title: The Des Lacs Wildlife Refuge, Dakota Datebook

notes_for_editor: The 1936 build and 1937 move rest on one compiled list (West Lookouts, not checked against a primary source). The FFLA coordinates (48.6849, -102.09208) may mark the 1936 site behind the HQ office or the 1937 site across the river; sources do not say which. The record status 'gone' is proposed as 'relocated' for a human decision. Searches surfaced a 1948 FWS photo titled as the Des Lacs refuge HQ, not fetched; check it for a tower and whether it is usable. A Kenmare 75th-anniversary article was not read. A December 1936 FWS release on CCC camps mentions lookout towers generically without naming this refuge, so it is not cited.
